notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
Several updates has been released since release with following improvements.

Scale UI (MouseWheel with LeftAlt, or LeftALt+LeftShift)
Move map (mouse drag)
Translation to Hungarian (thanks to Zsolt Brechler)
Combo Hint is showing over enemy in scene
Mapping keyboard
In-game help (F1)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27836980/d4349939e5aba38bf1cca7d23859bd188712a3ca.png

notes.title: Trailer and release date
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that The Keep, an old-school first person dungeon crawler with real-time combat is set to be released on 16th March 2017.

https://youtu.be/N16I3zEMfP4

Enter The Keep on March 16!
